course.title: Microwave Engineering and Radar
course.department: Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering

content.value: A signal generator is to feed equal power through a lossless air transmission line with a characteristic impedance 50 Ω to two separate resistive loads, 64 Ω and 25 Ω. Quarter wave transformers are used to match the loads to the 50 Ω line, as shown in figure below.
i) Determine the required characteristics impedances of the quarter wave line,
ii) Find the standing-wave ratio on the matching line sections.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2019
